maria: Hey folks — short notice: my flight got delayed, I need someone to cover my oncall shift Sun 18:00-23:00 ET. Will trade a weekday evening next week. :pray:

sam: I can take it but heads up I have a deploy scheduled 20:30-21:00 ET. If anything comes up during that window I might be slow to respond. Still okay for me to take the rest?

maria: Thanks @sam — that's fine. Quick handoff notes below.

maria: ```Handoff checklist:
- Primary channel: #incidents
- Escalation order: pager -> julian, then oncall-sre
- Key things to watch: model-serving error spike (v2 model), nightly logs-compact job at 22:15 ET, cache-eviction job at 22:45 ET
- Quick commands: `kubectl get pods -n inference`, `tail -n 200 /var/log/redwood/serving.log`
- Links: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall ; schedule: https://calendar.google.com/redwood/oncall
- Note: Admin creds are KMS-managed; contact #security for temporary access
```

alex: I can take instead if someone needs a cleaner slot — @sam if you're uncomfortable with the deploy overlap I'm happy to swap.

sam: @alex appreciate it, but I'm ok taking it. @maria can you add the span of coverage to the oncall spreadsheet? I can't edit right now.

maria: Done — updated the sheet and added the short notes. Also FYI there is a low-risk rolling restart Monday 03:00 UTC (scheduled infra work) but it shouldn't impact Sun evening. If you see model latency >300ms, escalate early.

julian: Added escalation contact numbers to the runbook (pager and cell). @sam thanks for covering. :tada:

oncall-bot: schedule updated — sam assigned to 2026-04-05T22:00-03:00Z slot by maria

sam: Got it. I'll be online at 17:50 ET to sync and run through the checklist. DM me if you want to walk through anything quick. :wave:

maria: Thank you all! I'll owe snacks next week. :coffee:
